messages.content: Write the invitation copy for a webinar about database performance tuning. Around 200 words.

output:
Passes clean. Here's the invitation copy:

---

Your database is slow, and you're tired of guessing why.

Join us for a live session on database performance tuning. We'll cover indexing strategy, query plan analysis, connection pooling, and the caching layer that stops repeat queries before they hit disk. Every topic comes with a real example: a query rewritten from 4 seconds to 40 milliseconds, an index that cut lock contention in half, a config change that doubled throughput under load.

This session works for two audiences. If you run production databases and want a repeatable process for finding the next bottleneck, you'll get that process. If you write application code and want to read an EXPLAIN plan without help, you'll leave able to do it.

Bring your own slow query. We're setting aside the last 15 minutes for live diagnosis, so send us a query ahead of time if you want it picked.

Date: [DATE]
Time: [TIME]
Format: Live, with recording sent to registrants afterward

Seats are limited to keep the Q&A useful. Register below to hold yours.

---

Fill in the date/time placeholders when you have them.
